DesiredStateEnvelope.duplicate-revocatio.note: Revocations must be a unique UUID array when present.

DesiredStateEnvelope.invalid-revocation-.note: Revocations must be a unique UUID array when present.

DesiredStateEnvelope.no-signatures.json.note: An unsigned envelope is a downgrade and is rejected (§16.2).

DesiredStateEnvelope.null-revocations.js.note: Revocations must be a unique UUID array when present.

DesiredStateEnvelope.probe-target-tamper.note: Changing a signed resolver reference or probe target must invalidate the envelope signature.

DesiredStateEnvelope.resolver-digest-tam.note: Changing a signed resolver reference or probe target must invalidate the envelope signature.

DesiredStateEnvelope.revocations-tampere.note: Removing a signed revocation invalidates the signature.

DesiredStateEnvelope.untrusted-key.json.note: Valid Ed25519 signature by a key that is not in the trust store.

ReleaseManifestEnvelope.tampered.json.note: product_version changed after signing; the trusted key's signature no longer verifies.

ServingLeaseEnvelope.wrong-purpose.json.note: Signed by the trusted desired-state key, which is not allowed for the lease purpose.

ServingReadEvidence.non-utc-read-at.json.note: ServingReadEvidence.read_at must be UTC RFC 3339 with Z.

ServingReadEvidence.numeric-candidate-ge.note: ServingReadEvidence.candidate_generation must be a decimal string, never a JSON number (§10.4).

ServingReadEvidence.unexpected-error-cod.note: ServingReadEvidence has no error_code member and sets additionalProperties: false (D-164).

ServingReadEvidence.unknown-source.json.note: ServingReadEvidence.source allows only apply or live (D-164).

UpdateResult.bad-candidate-health.json.note: candidate_health uses UpdateHealth; unknown check statuses are rejected (D-062).

UpdateResult.hash-mismatch.json.note: state changed without recomputing payload_hash; the center answers ACK_CONFLICT for a known result_id.

UpdateResult.numeric-policy-generation.j.note: Applied policy generation must never pass through a JSON number.

UpdateResult.policy-generation-tampered..note: Changing the applied policy generation changes the payload hash.

UsageEvent.numeric-bytes.json.note: Bytes must be a decimal string, never a JSON number (§10.4).
